products.title: Valuables Bag
products.body_html:
• Plush-Lined Interior - Internal pockets with soft lining help protect phones, sunglasses, and other valuables from scratches
  • Versatile Carry Options - Wear cross body or around the waist, whatever's most comfortable for you
  • Clicgear Compatible - Attaches securely to Clicgear mounting tabs for easy on-cart storage
  • Secure Zip Closure - Keeps your essentials safely stowed while you play
  • Compact, Everyday Size - Measures 8”x1.5”x6”

Keep your phone, wallet, keys, and other essentials secure and organized from the first tee to the clubhouse with the Clicgear Valuables Bag. A plush-lined interior protects your electronics and personal items, while the versatile cross-body or waist strap lets you wear it on the course or off. It attaches directly to Clicgear mounting tabs for hands-free convenience during your round, then comes with you to the 19th hole when you're done.

products.title: Trunk Caddy
products.body_html:
• Collapsible Design - Folds flat for easy, space-saving storage when not in use
  • Waterproof Liner - Wipes or hoses clean in seconds, keeping your trunk free of mud
  • Removable Changing Mat - Provides a clean surface for changing shoes or gear at the course
  • Rugged Build - Reinforced construction stands up to the weight and wear of cart transport
  • Generous Capacity - Expanded dimensions of 26" x 14" x 16" fits most push carts including all Clicgear 3-wheel models. Collapses to just 26" x 4" x 16”
Transport your cart to and from the course without ever worrying about mud or wet grass in your trunk. The Clicgear Trunk Caddy features a waterproof, hose-able liner that wipes clean in seconds, plus a removable changing mat so you can cleanly swap shoes or gear. When you're done, it collapses flat for compact, out-of-the-way storage. Sturdy and spacious, it's the easiest way to keep your car clean, round after round.

products.title: Travel Bag
products.body_html:
• 4-Wheel Checked Luggage Bag - Built to transport your folded cart and on-course gear as standard checked baggage
  • Waterproof, Hose-Able Liner - Protects contents and wipes or hoses clean in seconds
  • Stackable Travel System - Pairs with the Clicgear Carry-On Gear Bag for coordinated, easy travel
  • Smooth-Rolling Design - 4 spinner wheels easily glide through airports and parking lots
  • Travel-Ready Size - 31" x 15" x 17.5", sized to meet standard checked luggage
Get your cart to the next tournament or vacation round without the stress of checking oversized luggage or damaging your cart. The Clicgear Travel Bag is a rugged, 4-wheel checked bag built to hold your folded cart plus on-course gear, with a waterproof, hose-able liner that keeps everything protected and easy to clean. It rolls smoothly through airports, and stacks seamlessly with the Clicgear Carry-On Gear Bag for a complete, matched travel system from home to clubhouse.

products.title: Cary-On Bag
products.body_html:
• 4-Wheel Carry-On Design - Rolls smoothly and meets standard carry-on size requirements
  • Secure Interior Straps - Keep apparel and gear organized and in place while traveling
  • Front Zip Pocket - quick access to small essentials without opening the main compartment
  • Stackable Travel System - Pairs with the Clicgear Cart Travel Bag for coordinated, easy travel
  • Carry-On Ready Size - 23" x 9.1" x 14.6", built to fit standard overhead bin dimensions
Keep your apparel and gear organized and within reach with the Clicgear Carry-On Bag. Sized to meet standard carry-on requirements, it rolls smoothly on 4 spinner wheels and stows easily in the overhead bin. Interior straps keep contents secure in transit, while the front zip pocket keeps small essentials handy. Pair it with the Clicgear Cart Travel Bag for a complete, matched travel system from home to the clubhouse.

products.title: Cart Cooler Bag
products.body_html:
• 10-Can Capacity - Fits up to 10 cans giving you plenty of cold refreshment to last a full 18 holes without needing a refill.
  • Universal Cart Mounting - Designed to attach securely to Clicgear push carts and is compatible with most other cart brands, so it fits right into your existing setup.
  • Durable, Weather-Resistant Design - Constructed from rugged, water-resistant fabric that stands up to sun, rain, and everything the course throws at you
  • Compact, Cart-Ready Size - Measures 8”x7”x10”, small enough to stay out of the way, large enough to store all your dinks and snacks

Keep your drinks cold from the first tee to the eighteenth green with the Clicgear Cart Cooler. This insulated cooler holds up to 10 cans plus ice, so your favorite beverages stay refreshingly cold throughout your entire round. Its universal mounting system attaches securely to Clicgear push carts as well as most other cart brands, making it an easy add-on for any golfer's setup. Compact yet spacious, it's the perfect on-course companion for hot days and long rounds.

products.title: Weekend Backpack
products.body_html:
• Stand-Up Design - Opens flat and stays upright for easy packing and unpacking
  • Luggage Pass-Through - Slides onto rolling luggage handles for effortless travel
  • Secure-Zip Organization Pocket - External pocket with dividers keeps smaller items sorted and accessible
  • Versatile Everyday Use - Equally suited to weekend trips or daily commuting
Whether you're heading out for a weekend trip or just your daily commute, the Clicgear Weekend Backpack keeps you organized and ready to go. Its stand-up design opens flat for easy packing and unpacking, while a luggage pass-through lets you slide it right onto a rolling luggage handle for effortless airport transfers. An external, secure-zip pocket with dividers keeps smaller items like chargers, toiletries, and accessories organized and easy to find.
